svg.title: Tarankan Exim — 10-Step Quality Inspection Journey
svg.desc: A landscape quality journey. The camera travels upward through ten checkpoints while a synchronized arrow reveals the route immediately behind it. Step 01 is repeated just beyond Step 10 so the final frame and first frame are identical, creating a seamless continuous loop.
